entries.rationale: Owner-authorised dev/trial local hash pin, verified against 2026-10-30 integration inputs; no redistribution URL. Family delivery remains dk-85261627.
Owner-authorised private fork; dev/trial-only hash-addressed local cache. No redistribution URL; family delivery remains dk-85261627.

Library (with bundled DungeonConfig) whose only consumer was Let Me Despawn (dropped). Closure 2026-11-01: migrate.mjs resolve (declared dependencies) plus a class-reference scan of every lock jar, 81 nested jar-in-jar and both owned jars (jobs/2026-11-01-evileye-tweaks-wave4/library-closure.json): no declared dependency and no com/frikinjay/almanac or dungeonconfig class reference outside the dropped mods.

Replaced by the owned Evil Eye Client 0.1.0 (food/: overlays, previews, tooltips, F3; config/appleskin-client.toml carried into [food]; Thirst Was Taken AppleSkin-gated overlays redrawn by its thirst adapter) and Evil Eye Tweaks 0.3.0 (food/: saturation/exhaustion snapshots). No world data.

Owner's port (minecraft-mods, public LGPL fork), fourth of the seven: Ars Instrumentum 5.0.0 built from dc29a50; mod id and all 9 registry / 43 recipe-data ids of 4.1.0 kept. Requires Ars Nouveau [5.13.3,) and Curios. Direct GitHub release pin, sha256 = release digest; no update table.

Replaced by the owned Evil Eye Tweaks 0.4.0 (entity/attributes/: the five one-million maxima AttributeFix 21.1.3 applied, set once at common setup before any world loads). config/attributefix.json used an obsolete format the 1.21.1 jar never read; the effective values were the jar's defaults. No world data.

Library whose only consumers were Crafting Tweaks and Default Options (dropped). Closure 2026-11-01: migrate.mjs resolve (declared dependencies) plus a class-reference scan of 254 jars (every lock jar, 79 nested jar-in-jar, both owned jars; jobs/2026-11-01-evileye-wave3/library-closure.json): no declared dependency; the one other net/blay09/mods/balm reference is Xaero's Minimap SupportWaystones, loaded only when Waystones is installed (it is not). config/balm-common.toml (Balm's example settings) goes with it.

Replaced by the owned Evil Eye Client 0.2.0 (screens/advancements/: full-size advancements screen with config/betteradvancements-client.toml's colours, background fade, criteria detail Default without Shift, ui scaling 100, unsorted tabs). Client-only; vanilla advancement ids and progress untouched; no world data.

Library whose only consumer was AttributeFix (dropped). Closure 2026-11-01: migrate.mjs resolve (declared dependencies) plus a class-reference scan of every lock jar, 81 nested jar-in-jar and both owned jars (jobs/2026-11-01-evileye-tweaks-wave4/library-closure.json): no declared dependency and no net/darkhax/bookshelf class reference outside the dropped mods.

Owner decision 2026-11-02: remove Chloride entirely; graphics tweaks are unused. Modern UI remains as the zoom provider, default Z. Sodium remains required by Iris; bundled WaterConfig leaves with Chloride.

Replaced by the owned Evil Eye Tweaks 0.4.0 (entity/experience/: orbs of any value clump, one-touch pick-up, Mending per original orb). Five orbs in the converted world carry Clumps' clumpedMap; LegacyClumpsOrbData converts them on load (true totals; read as vanilla orbs they would pay Value x Count).

Library whose only consumer was Double Doors (dropped). Closure 2026-11-01: 270 jars from the lock incl. 81 nested jar-in-jar scanned, no Collective metadata dependency or com/natamus/collective class reference (jobs/2026-11-01-evileye-tweaks-wave1/collective-closure.json).

Replaced by the owned Evil Eye Client 0.1.0 (health/: coloured heart rows and status palettes, tinted from the active pack hearts; config/colorfulhearts.toml carried into [health]). Client-only; no world data.

Replaced by the owned Evil Eye Tweaks 0.4.0 (entity/pets/: shoulder dismount rules, portal/respawn/chunk-unload/follow-failure teleports, injured-pet rules and sweep protection with Companion 6.3.0's defaults, which equal config/companion-common.yaml). Its three game rules sat at their defaults in the converted world (petFriendlyFire true, immortalPets false, alwaysTeleportHorses false) and are not carried as game rules. No entity data.

Replaced by the owned Evil Eye Client 0.2.0 (screens/controls/: Key Binds search by name/category/key, unbound and conflict filters, A-Z/Z-A sort, free-keys list, reset all with confirmation; vanilla editing). No config or saved data; bindings stay in options.txt.

Replaced by the owned Evil Eye Tweaks 0.7.0 cosmetic armour and Evil Eye Client 0.4.0 equipment panel; existing items are imported by Evil Eye World Migration 0.1.0-dev.11 convert-all (playerdata/<uuid>.cosarmor -> evileye_tweaks:cosmetic_armor_v1).

Replaced only by Evil Eye Client's hidden recipe-book button (0.2.0, kept in 0.3.2 as inventory/recipebook/). Its crafting keys and server actions (Evil Eye Tweaks 0.5.0 inventory/crafting) were ported in wave 3 and removed again in Client 0.3.2 and Tweaks 0.6.0 by owner decision (unused); EMI's + recipe fill and DankRecipeTransfer are unaffected. No world data (only the level.dat mod list names it).
Official project has no NeoForge 1.21.1 build; unofficial NeoForge port 0.3.0-beta.2 (survey replacement), vetted against Create's version by the dependency check.
Reforged has no NeoForge 1.21.1 build; the NeoForge port 1.4.3 (survey replacement) requires Kotlin for Forge, already in the pack. Pinned by sha256 because the release tag name is not versioned.

Owner's port (minecraft-mods), first of the seven: 0.2.1 prerelease built from 6605b8d fixes the client-only JEI recipe-transfer verifier failure in 0.2.0; same mod id and frozen NeoForge/Dank Storage/viewer targets. Direct GitHub release pin, sha256 checked against the release digest; no update table.

Replaced by the owned Evil Eye Client 0.2.0 (options/defaults/: config/defaultoptions/keybindings.txt becomes each listed key's default and its value where options.txt had none at startup; options.txt and servers.dat copied on a fresh instance). Same folder and file syntax, so the keymap needs no move; Crafting Tweaks keys saved under their old names carry over once.
Replaced by the owned Evil Eye Tweaks 0.2.0 (doors/: hand, villager and redstone sync with Double Doors 7.5 defaults, carried in config/evileye_tweaks-common.toml). No blocks, items or world data.
Superseded by Sodium, the renderer Iris requires on NeoForge; Embeddium and Sodium cannot be installed together.

Replaced by the owned Evil Eye Client 0.1.0 (tooltips/enchantments/: same key convention, original vanilla descriptions; config/enchdesc.json was an obsolete format, effective defaults carried into [enchantments]). No world data.

Owned client mod (minecraft-mods/mods/EvilEyeClient f622b5d, private local pin until a canonical release): replaces Yeetus Experimentus, Pick Up Notifier, Stylish Effects, Colorful Hearts, Enchantment Descriptions and AppleSkin (consolidation wave 2), and Better Advancements, Controlling, Default Options, Resource Pack Overrides, Just Enough Professions, Mouse Tweaks and Crafting Tweaks' hidden recipe-book button (wave 3; its crafting keys were removed in 0.3.2, unused); wave 5 adds FTB Library's inventory sidebar.; 0.4.0 adds the equipment panel (Curios key G and the inventory button open one panel: equipped curios, real armour, model, cosmetic armour, cosmetic curios) and cosmetic armour rendering, replacing Cosmetic Armor Reworked's screen and rendering (equipment panel wave). Round-4 owned sorting and physical-storage/Dank transfers complete the bounded IPN replacement; both-hand refill remains enabled. IPN/libIPN removed together, Kotlin retained. Release 2026-11-02: 0.6.1 from minecraft-mods 8195659; settings screen/service metadata and outside-panel inventory action rail. IPN replacement retained. Wave 6: Client 0.7.0 absorbs Pro Placer reach-around, continuous placement and creative row/column breaking; no server protocol. Puzzles Lib stays for Diagonal Fences. Stable feedback 2026-11-02: Client 0.7.1 stabilizes the sort rail, consumes sort guards once and fixes client-only Dank inventory sync; no config or server protocol change. Paired Stable release: Client 0.8.0 repairs IMC dispatch, guards null Ponder cameras in Interstellaris, recovers pause-menu settings placement and adds an opt-in FPS HUD. Paired Stable release 2026-11-03: Client 0.9.0 adds equipment tabs, readable settings, the pause eye logo, string-backed choices and matching-click/Shift-click-all transfers. Client 0.10.0 attaches equipment tabs, expands paged attributes/effects with live icons and durations, and themes the pause eye button; config and Tweaks 0.11.0 compatibility are unchanged.

Owned mod (minecraft-mods/mods/EvilEyeEssentials d2da76e, private local pin until a canonical release): replaces FTB Essentials and, with Evil Eye Client 0.3.0, FTB Library (consolidation wave 5). Release 2026-11-02: 0.2.0 from minecraft-mods 2d258ea; settings screen/service metadata. IPN replacement retained.

Private local migration bridge built from minecraft-mods 3a0dcc8 (dev.11: imports Cosmetic Armor Reworked sidecars playerdata/<uuid>.cosarmor into Evil Eye Tweaks' cosmetic armour on convert-all; includes dev.10's empty-region scan fix and dev.8 Ars armor perks). Keep installed until every chunk, player including offline, colony and Dank store has been loaded and saved and pending evileye_migration:smelter_items / refunds lists are drained. Dev.5 convert-all/status is planned for cutover.

Owned mod (minecraft-mods/mods/EvilEyeTweaks fce93f3, private local pin until a canonical release): forced-fuel furnace routing and paired doors/gates/trapdoors (consolidation wave 1), pick-up receipts and food snapshots for Evil Eye Client (wave 2), and attribute limits, pet rules, tree felling, flat bedrock, day length, orb clumping and despawn rules (wave 4); 0.6.1 adds the Slow Falling drop threshold (owner request, not a replacement).; 0.7.0 adds owned cosmetic armour storage (player persistent data, replaces Cosmetic Armor Reworked) and the evileye_tweaks:equipment menu (equipment panel wave). Round-4 owned sorting and physical-storage/Dank transfers complete the bounded IPN replacement; both-hand refill remains enabled. IPN/libIPN removed together, Kotlin retained. Release 2026-11-02: 0.9.0 from minecraft-mods 42406c6; settings screen/service metadata. IPN replacement retained. Paired Stable release: Tweaks 0.10.0 repairs IMC dispatch and admits ordinary/trapped Iron Chests physical storage up to 108 slots; Dirt stays excluded. Inventory sorting negotiates protocol 2. Paired Stable release 2026-11-03: Tweaks 0.11.0 adds optional inventory_transfer_v2 matching transfers alongside compatible v1 ALL; common config is unchanged.

Replaced by the owned Evil Eye Tweaks 0.4.0 (world/trees/: instant whole-tree felling with config/fallingtree.json's values: scan 500, tree 100 with abort, furthest first, no mixed logs, crouch for one log, normal wear, leaf decay; /treefelling toggle keeps the fallingtree-disabled player tag). FallingTree 1.21.1.11 registers no enchantment or component; no player in the converted world had the tag.
Replaced by the owned Evil Eye Tweaks 0.4.0 (world/bedrock/: the bedrock_floor and bedrock_roof gradients become one layer in new chunks). Existing terrain unchanged; no data.

Owner's port (minecraft-mods), third of the seven: FlatWorldFix 1.0.0 for NeoForge 1.21.1, built from 26b2fd2 (fork of 1.20.1 f872a37), mod id unchanged. Kept and ported rather than swapped for Give Me My Flat World. Direct GitHub release pin, sha256 checked against the release digest; no update table.

Replaced by the owned Evil Eye Essentials 0.1.0 (homes, warps, /back, spawn, tpa, rtp, kits, nicknames, mutes, fly/god, heal/feed, invsee, enderchest, trash can, virtual workstations; the pack values from defaultconfigs/ftbessentials-server.snbt are its defaults). Saved data <world>/ftbessentials is imported once on server start (checksum-keyed, backed up, never overwriting); import trial on a copy of the NeoForge trial world: 2 players, 1 home, 20 /back entries, 0 conflicts (minecraft-mods jobs/2026-11-01-evileye-essentials-wave5/import-trial).

Library whose only consumer was FTB Essentials (dropped); its inventory sidebar buttons (gamemode, day, night, rain, trash can) are rebuilt in Evil Eye Client 0.3.0. Closure 2026-11-01: no other lock entry declares ftblibrary, and a class-reference scan of every remaining pinned jar finds no dev/ftb/mods/ftblibrary reference (jobs/2026-11-01-evileye-essentials-wave5/ftb-closure.txt). Architectury stays: Quick Skin requires it.
Replaced by the owned Evil Eye Tweaks 0.2.0 (furnace/ forced-fuel routing, same fuelgoeshere:forced_fuels tag id and coal/charcoal default). No config, blocks, items or world data.

Replaced by the owned Evil Eye Tweaks 0.4.0 (world/time/: Overworld day 0.5, night 1.0 through NeoForge's day-time rate; weather pacing SLEEPING; vanilla sleep). defaultconfigs/hourglass-server.toml values carried into [time]; Hourglass kept no world data.
Owner-authorised dev/trial local hash pin, verified against 2026-10-30 integration inputs; no redistribution URL. Family delivery remains dk-85261627.

Plan Phase 7, last in dependency order: Interstellaris 0.6.1 beta (2026-10-27, WIP space mod; full release estimated Q2 2027). Requires Mekanism + Generators [10.7.19,10.8) and Sable [2.0.5,2.1), both pinned; CurseForge only (no Modrinth project).

Replaced by Evil Eye Client 0.5.1 and Tweaks 0.8.1: owned middle-click sorting, directional physical-storage/Dank transfers and both-hand refill. Recursive final-pin closure recorded under jobs/2026-11-02-ipn-round4. Kotlin retained for Create Jetpack, FlightLib and Cull Less Leaves.

Flywheel 1.0.6 marks its instancing and indirect backends unsupported while an Iris shaderpack is active (Backends.java supported() checks !ShadersModHelper.isShaderPackInUse), so Create kinetic block entities fall back to the CPU. This mod (2.4.0 release, NeoForge 1.21.1, requires Iris and Sodium) merges Flywheel shaders into the pack gbuffer_block program so instancing runs with shaders on. Owner profiling request 2026-11-01.
Jade 15.10.3 is the last 1.21.1 build compatible with Thirst Was Taken 2.1.5's mandatory FluidView redirect.
Ice and Fire CE 2.1.4 dependency; exact file and SHA-256 supplied by minecraft-mods (2026-10-30).

Replaced by the owned Evil Eye Client 0.2.0 (integration/professions/: JEI "Professions" category, every registered profession with a job-site block, villager model, emerald and spawn-egg catalysts; shown in EMI through its JEI bridge). No data.

Library whose only consumer was Companion (dropped). Closure 2026-11-01: migrate.mjs resolve (declared dependencies) plus a class-reference scan of every lock jar, 81 nested jar-in-jar and both owned jars (jobs/2026-11-01-evileye-tweaks-wave4/library-closure.json): no declared dependency on kiwi and no snownee/kiwi class reference outside the dropped mods; fabric_api_base, which Kiwi bundled, is still bundled by Sodium and Iris. No kiwi: ids in the converted world.

Replaced by the owned Evil Eye Tweaks 0.4.0 (entity/despawn/: pick-ups no longer pin mobs and drop on despawn, spawner and trial-spawner rules, endermen, corpse:corpse kept as in config/letmedespawn/letmedespawn.json5). No letmedespawn_* or almanac_picked_slots keys in the converted world; LegacyDespawnData reads them if a world has any.

Replaced by Evil Eye Client 0.5.1 and Tweaks 0.8.1: owned middle-click sorting, directional physical-storage/Dank transfers and both-hand refill. Recursive final-pin closure recorded under jobs/2026-11-02-ipn-round4. Kotlin retained for Create Jetpack, FlightLib and Cull Less Leaves.
Owner request 2026-11-01: not used. Client-only light-level overlay (no blocks, items or world data).
Required by L_Ender's Cataclysm (declares 3.1); 3.1 is the newest NeoForge 1.21.1 release.
Plan Phase 7: Mekanism Generators 10.7.19.85 (pairs with Mekanism 10.7.19.85, its Modrinth dependency); required by Interstellaris 0.6.1.
Plan Phase 7 (Interstellaris stack), first in dependency order: Mekanism 10.7.19.85, inside Interstellaris 0.6.1's published range 10.7.19-10.7.x. The main jar, not the -api file.

Replaced by the owned Evil Eye Client 0.2.0 (inventory/gestures/: right-drag spread, left-drag gather or shift-move, shift-left-drag move, wheel transfer last-to-first, normal direction, proportional scaling: config/MouseTweaks.cfg's values). Only vanilla clicks, so the server validates every move; no data.
Oculus has no NeoForge 1.21.1 build; Iris 1.8.14-beta.1 is the supported NeoForge shader loader (survey replacement).

Replaced by the owned Evil Eye Client 0.1.0 (pickup/: pick-up log with Pick Up Notifier 21.1.1 defaults; untracked upstream config, defaults carried) and Evil Eye Tweaks 0.3.0 (pickup/: backpack receipts). No blocks, items or world data.

Reimplemented in Evil Eye Client 0.7.0: enabled reach-around, continuous placement and creative breaking; exact scaffolding exclusion and session toggle. Puzzles Lib and Diagonal Fences retained. Recursive closure and saved-inventory evidence: jobs/2026-11-02-pro-placer.
MemoryLeakFix (misnamed metafile): no NeoForge 1.21.1 build; ModernFix, retained, covers the modern memory fixes (plan Phase 5).
Create 6.0.10's neoforge.mods.toml declares radium incompatible (FML refuses to load both); Create is core content. Revisit if a later Create build lifts it.
Modrinth only tags 1.21; CurseForge tags the same file for 1.21.1 (survey cross-check).

Replaced by the owned Evil Eye Client 0.2.0 (options/resourcepacks/: default_packs order on a first launch, Eat Quiet required, New Hearts force-compatible, failed-reload fallback, vanilla kept lowest). The policy moves from config/resourcepackoverrides.json (preserved, so stale ids never reached installs) to config/evileye_client/resourcepacks.json with the NeoForge pack ids corrected.

Owner's port (minecraft-mods), second of the seven: 0.17.0 prerelease built from 5e8988e (fork of 1.20.1 4a3bdfb; Stable baseline v0.13.3 = 4f4776e). Registry and blockstate ids unchanged; door-use packet protocol 2. Direct GitHub release pin, sha256 checked against the release digest; no update table.

Plan Phase 7, second in dependency order: Sable 2.0.6 (moving-sublevel physics; bundles Veil 4.3.2, Sable Companion 1.6.0 and its Rapier physics library), inside Interstellaris 0.6.1's range 2.0.5-2.0.x. Declares Sodium >= 0.8.12-alpha.2 (pack: 0.8.13) and is incompatible with ScalableLux (absent).

Library whose only consumer was Controlling (dropped). Closure 2026-11-01: migrate.mjs resolve (declared dependencies) plus a class-reference scan of 254 jars (every lock jar, 79 nested jar-in-jar, both owned jars; jobs/2026-11-01-evileye-wave3/library-closure.json): no declared dependency and no com/blamejared/searchables class reference outside the dropped mods.
Required by Iris 1.8.14-beta.1 (its Modrinth dependency pins this version); replaces Embeddium.
Owner request 2026-11-01: profiler for in-game profiling of the Trial (client) and server; spark 1.10.124 is the newest NeoForge 1.21.1 release.

Replaced by the owned Evil Eye Client 0.1.0 (effects/: compact HUD and screen widgets carrying config/stylisheffects-client.toml into config/evileye_client-client.toml [effects]). Client-only; no world data.
Owner request 2026-11-01: removed. Tool Belt (toolbelt:belt, toolbelt:pouch) is removed without a world-content rescue (owner re-scope 2026-11-01); belts or pouches left in a world lose their items.
Ice and Fire CE 2.1.4 dependency; exact file and SHA-256 supplied by minecraft-mods (2026-10-30).
Replaced by the owned Evil Eye Client 0.1.0 (warnings/: experimental-settings prompts skipped without changing world lifecycle or saved flags). Client-only; no blocks, items, config or world data.
pinned version is not tagged 1.21.1; newest tagged release 9.6

frozen.reason: Agreed with minecraft-mods: the seven ports build against NeoForge 21.1.265, JEI 19.70.0.464, EMI 1.1.24, Polymorph 1.2.0 and Dank Storage 20.
